summary: Share pages now use a two-column media strip (left venue/cab photo, right OSM static map pin at zoom 11 city/prefecture level). Primary og:image stays the venue/cab photo; a second og:image points at the static map URL when coords exist. Map column caption is country / pref. Map img has onerror to hide the map column if staticmap.openstreetmap.de is down. Browser redirect delayed 2s (immediate with ?go=1); bots never redirect. Added --only SID... for partial regen. Full rebuild wrote 11856 pages in ~6s (5072 venue photos, 11792 with map).
how_to_verify: Open s/z195.html (Quantum SM City Bacolod, no venue photo): dual card, cabinet left, map pin Philippines right; 2s redirect; ?go=1 immediate.
Open s/b1.html (街机烈火, venue photo): dual card, assets/venues/cn/1.jpg left, China / 上海 map right; two og:image meta tags.
View source: first og:image = photo, second = staticmap.openstreetmap.de with red-pushpin; twitter:image stays photo only.
python scrapers/build_share_pages.py --only z195 b1  for quick regen.
risks: Discord/Twitter unfurl only reliably shows ONE og:image (the first/photo). Second map og:image is best-effort for clients that support multi-image; humans who open the link always see both columns.

staticmap.openstreetmap.de is a free third-party service with no SLA. DNS/probe from this agent host failed (getaddrinfo); onerror hides the map column if the image fails to load. No API key, but rate limits or downtime are possible.
Map tiles attribution is not shown on the small card (space-constrained). Acceptable for a share preview; full map on the main site has proper attribution.
Only ~64 arcades lack coords and skip the map column (11856-11792).
Live GitHub Pages still serves old pages until deploy/push (this agent does not commit or push).
